items.title_en: Baidu ERNIE Releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview Model, Weights to Be Open-Sourced by November 25
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，百度文心大模型今日发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview ，这是基于此前发布的 Base 模型 的首个后训练版本。 该模型总参数 280B，激活参数 14B，支持 1M 上下文，官方称在编程、3D 建模、知识工作、内容创作等方面表现出色。 据介绍，ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 兼顾了智能水平和推理效率。在多项基准测试中，ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 取得了具有竞争力的得分，同时保持了极致的解码速度。模型 API 已在 千帆平台 上线， 权重将于 11 月 25 日前开源 。 IT之家附基准测试结果如下： 官方表示，ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 是后训练过程中的一个中间版本，尽管它已经取得同尺寸模型中较有竞争力的表现，但仍可能存在部分因训练不充分导致的能力缺陷。后训练仍在进行中，ERNIE 5.5 Flash 还在快速进化，将密切关注 Preview 模型在真实场景中的实际表现和用户反馈， 并在后续正式版本中进行优化 。 相关阅读： 《 百度文心开源发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 高效基座模型，总参数 280B 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 11 that Baidu's ERNIE large model team released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the first post-trained version based on the previously released Base model. The model has 280B total parameters and 14B activated parameters, supports a 1M context, and the company says it performs well in coding, 3D modeling, knowledge work, and content creation. It is described as balancing intelligence and inference efficiency, scoring competitively on multiple benchmarks while maintaining very fast decoding speed. The model API is now available on the Qianfan platform, and the weights will be open-sourced by November 25. The company said the model is an intermediate version in the post-training process; although it is competitive among models of the same size, some capability gaps caused by insufficient training may remain. Post-training continues and ERNIE 5.5 Flash is still evolving quickly; the team will monitor the Preview model's real-world performance and user feedback and optimize in the later official release.
items.why_zh: 推测：后训练中间版本即上线 API 并承诺开源权重，若兑现，将让 280B 总参数、14B 激活的模型进入可自托管阵营，但其实际能力仍需第三方评测验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: releasing an API and promising open weights for an intermediate post-training version could, if delivered, put a 280B-total/14B-active model into the self-hostable camp, though its real capabilities still need third-party evaluation.

items.title_zh: 阿里 Qwen Code 1.0 发布：Qoder 与 Qwen Code Harness 融合开源
items.title_en: Alibaba Releases Qwen Code 1.0, Open-Sourcing Merged Qoder and Qwen Code Harness Capabilities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，阿里今日官宣推出 Qwen Code 1.0 版本， Qoder 与 Qwen Code 融合开源 。 阿里把在 Qoder 中打磨的 Harness 能力融入 Qwen Code，随 Qwen Code 1.0 Preview 一起开放，为开发者提供可嵌入自身产品的 Agent 运行基础。 Qwen Code 1.0 从进程内的内存事件总线起步，沿着统一事件模型向分布式演进：将接入、调度与执行分层扩展，通过“手脑分离”让推理编排与工具执行独立管理。在保留既有入口与返回方式的基础上， 从“一个进程、多个会话”走向“多个节点、更多会话” 。 Qwen Code 1.0 架构演进示意 阿里官方表示，统一事件机制不仅连接入口与任务，也为能力扩展和资源管理建立清晰边界。各类处理单元围绕事件协作，模型、沙箱与外部扩展分别管理，让系统在承接更多任务时，更便于扩展能力、集中管控和控制成本。 处理单元灵活扩展：推理、记忆与工具能力可以围绕事件按需接入，减少对主执行流程的侵入。 模型接入集中管控：模型服务通过统一入口接入，集中管理配置、访问授权与调用记录，减少重复对接与分散维护。 沙箱资源按需管理：在相同配置与权限边界内分配和复用，减少重复初始化与空闲占用，有助于降低运行成本。 系统扩展集中治理：统一管理 MCP 的配置、授权与连接，减少分散维护。 本次发布将 Qoder 与 Qwen Code 的 Harness 能力纳入同一套开源内核。Harness 负责衔接模型、工具与执行过程，开发者可以据此构建适合自身场景的 Agent 系统，将 AI 编程能力接入更完整的工作流程。 Qwen Code 1.0 Preview 以独立分支开放， 现有稳定分支继续保留 。团队将沿着 1.0 的演进路线，持续完善功能覆盖与稳定性。 IT之家附开源地址如下： https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 11 that Alibaba announced Qwen Code 1.0, open-sourcing a merger of Qoder and Qwen Code. Alibaba integrated the Harness capabilities refined in Qoder into Qwen Code and released them with Qwen Code 1.0 Preview, giving developers an Agent runtime foundation they can embed in their own products. Qwen Code 1.0 starts from an in-process, in-memory event bus and evolves toward distribution along a unified event model: access, scheduling, and execution are scaled in layers, and a separation of reasoning orchestration from tool execution is achieved; while keeping existing entry points and return methods, it moves from one process with multiple sessions to multiple nodes with more sessions. Alibaba says the unified event mechanism connects entry points and tasks and sets clear boundaries for capability extension and resource management, with processing units cooperating around events and models, sandboxes, and external extensions managed separately. Specifically: processing units scale flexibly, with reasoning, memory, and tool capabilities plugged in on demand; model access is centrally controlled through a unified entry point for configuration, authorization, and call records; sandbox resources are allocated and reused on demand within the same configuration and permission boundaries; and system extensions such as MCP configuration, authorization, and connections are centrally governed. The release brings Qoder and Qwen Code Harness capabilities into one open-source kernel; Harness connects models, tools, and execution, letting developers build Agent systems for their own scenarios. Qwen Code 1.0 Preview is released on a separate branch, while the existing stable branch is retained.
items.why_zh: 推测：把 Agent 运行内核开源，可能降低企业自建编程智能体的接入与运维门槛，但实际易用性尚需开发者实践检验。
items.why_en: Speculation: open-sourcing an Agent runtime kernel may lower the barrier for enterprises building their own coding agents, though real-world usability still needs developer scrutiny.

items.title_en: Microsoft Lobbies US Government to Drop Restrictions on Chinese Optical Transceivers, Fearing Delays to AI Data Center Buildout
items.summary_zh: 11 月 11 日，据路透社报道，微软正游说特朗普政府放弃限制进口中国新型号光收发器的计划。微软与其他科技企业及行业组织认为，中国光收发器一旦遭到限制，可能造成关键零部件短缺，进一步拖慢美国 AI 数据中心建设。 知情人士称，微软等企业今年 9 月曾与白宫科技政策办公室及美国国家安全委员会官员会面，就潜在禁令可能造成的供应链问题提出担忧。市场研究机构 Cleanview 的数据显示，微软目前在美国有 35 座数据中心正在建设，另有 134 座处于规划阶段。 美国联邦通信委员会正在研究相关限制，但尚未公布最终规则。美国政府提出限制的理由是，中国制造的新型号光模块可能被用于窃取数据、植入恶意软件或干扰数据中心服务。两名消息人士称，FCC 正在考虑将传输速率达到 3.2Tbps 的中国光模块纳入限制范围。摩根士丹利预计，这类产品将在 2028 年进入规模化生产，2029 年开始广泛部署。 Counterpoint Research 的数据显示，中国厂商约占全球光收发器市场的三分之二。美国企业 Coherent 和 Lumentum 也生产相关产品，但美国创新基金会认为，两家企业目前的产能规模尚不足以快速替代中国供应商。 美国信息技术产业委员会此前已致信 FCC，要求其不要将光收发器列入贸易限制清单。该组织认为，不少云计算企业已经提前采购 AI 芯片，如果缺少光模块完成设备互联，这些芯片可能无法按计划投入使用。与此同时，美国国会两党议员已提出法案，拟禁止敏感联邦系统采用中国制造的光收发器。 相关阅读： 《 美国 AI 数据中心反对声浪高涨，软银考虑转向其他国家寻找增长机会 》
items.summary_en: November 11 (Reuters): Microsoft is lobbying the Trump administration to abandon a plan to restrict imports of new-model Chinese optical transceivers. Microsoft, other tech companies and industry groups argue that restricting Chinese transceivers could cause shortages of critical components and further slow US AI data center construction. People familiar with the matter say Microsoft and others met with White House Office of Science and Technology Policy and National Security Council officials in September to raise concerns about supply chain problems a potential ban could cause. Cleanview data shows Microsoft currently has 35 data centers under construction in the US and another 134 in planning. The Federal Communications Commission is studying the restrictions but has not published a final rule. The US government's stated rationale is that new-model Chinese optical modules could be used to steal data, implant malware or disrupt data center services. Two sources say the FCC is considering covering Chinese optical modules with transmission rates of 3.2Tbps. Morgan Stanley expects such products to reach volume production in 2028 and broad deployment in 2029. Counterpoint Research data shows Chinese vendors account for about two-thirds of the global optical transceiver market. US firms Coherent and Lumentum also make such products, but the Foundation for American Innovation argues their current capacity is insufficient to quickly replace Chinese suppliers. The Information Technology Industry Council previously wrote to the FCC asking it not to put optical transceivers on trade restriction lists, arguing that many cloud companies have already bought AI chips in advance, and without optical modules to interconnect equipment those chips may not be deployed as planned. Meanwhile, bipartisan US lawmakers have introduced a bill to ban Chinese-made optical transceivers from sensitive federal systems.
items.why_zh: 推测：若限制落地，可能同时影响美国 AI 基础设施的部署节奏与全球光模块供应链格局，但目前 FCC 尚未公布最终规则。
items.why_en: Speculation: if restrictions take effect they could affect both the pace of US AI infrastructure deployment and the global optical module supply chain, though the FCC has not yet issued a final rule.

items.summary_zh: “IT早报”时间，大家好，现在是 2026 年 11 月 11 日星期三，今天的重要科技资讯有： 1. items.summary_en: The 'IT Morning Brief' for Wednesday, November 11, 2026 covers: 1. Anthropic released an IPO roadshow video, formally launching a fundraising plan of up to $64.35 billion, issuing 825 million shares; combined with a $26 billion private placement, total financing reaches $90.4 billion, with a valuation range of $1 trillion to $1.4 trillion, and Google, Nvidia and others participating. 2. On November 10 Anthropic released two frontier models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which it says bring notable gains in coding, reasoning, scientific research, cybersecurity and robotics, with output speed up to 30% faster and costs 20% lower. 3. Dong Mingzhu responded to Gree Electric's performance decline by citing rising copper prices, saying she would rather lose several billion yuan in profit than lower product quality, and that aluminum is feasible but its stability, reliability and durability are open to question. 4. Google opened access to its strongest reasoning model, Gemini 4 Carbon, supporting multimodal input with up to one million tokens of output, aimed at complex coding, research and cybersecurity. 5. Tipster Lusi Roy leaked a mockup of Apple's iPhone Air 2, showing thickness reduced from 5.6mm to 5.2mm, a new 48MP ultra-wide rear camera, an A20 chip and a 3500mAh battery. 6. Huawei's Kirin official account on November 10 detailed the Kirin 9050 series, its first chip using 'logic folding' τ technology, said to upgrade eight core units — compute, AI, graphics, imaging, communications, audio/video, display and security — with transistor density up 53.5%. 7. Real phone numbers for food delivery and ride-hailing will be hidden; Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud and eight other first-batch companies were approved for 700 dedicated number pilots, so users who opt in communicate via 15-digit numbers starting with 700. 8. Apple's first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, is releasing inventory, with several Apple Stores in China offering same-day in-store pickup for some models; first-sale volume approached 200,000 units. 9. DigiTimes reports Apple plans to switch the iPad Air to OLED panels in the first half of next year, expected to remain at 60Hz, using a single-layer OLED structure and LTPS backplane, positioned below the tandem-OLED+LTPO iPad Pro; Samsung Display will supply most panels and BOE is also seeking orders. 10. The full list of the 39th China Golden Rooster Awards was announced, with winners including 'Nobody' (Langlangshan Xiao Yaoguai), 'Blue Star Outside the Window', 'A Letter to Grandma' and 'Nanjing Photo Studio'. 11. Chinese animated film 'Langlangshan Xiao Yaoguai' won Best Animated Feature at the 39th Golden Rooster Awards; the film broke out last summer, has grossed over 1.719 billion yuan, is the highest-grossing 2D animated film in Chinese box office history and holds a 8.5 Douban rating. 12. Dong Mingzhu said Gree will have a product by year-end that can redefine home appliances (the original text is truncated here).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，湖南省政府新闻办今日召开新闻发布会，宣布 2026 世界计算大会将于 11 月 19 日至 21 日在长沙国际会议中心举行。 本届大会以“计算万物湘约未来 —— 打造智能经济新形态”为主题，设置“1+5+N+1”共 21 场主题活动。 大会核心议程围绕“十五五”时期计算产业发展方向展开解读，将集中发布计算产业分析、算力发展趋势、计算行业标准等一批研究报告，以及算电协同、基础设施、计算软硬件等产业成果。 主题论坛覆盖计算芯片、算电协同、AI 服务器、具身智能计算等领域，其中太空计算与海洋计算声学为首次设立。开幕式暨主旨论坛拟邀请诺贝尔奖获得者、中外院士及国内外领军企业家发表演讲，议题聚焦智能制造、半导体、人工智能、算力等前沿方向。 本届大会首次采用市场化运作方式，将往届专题展升级为 2026 计算产业博览会，规划展出面积 1 万平方米，预计 80 余家国内外计算领域企业参展。博览会集中展示具身智能机器人、脑机接口等创新产品。同期还将举办亚太机器人世界杯长沙国际邀请赛、研究生创“芯”大赛等赛事活动。 IT之家注：世界计算大会自 2019 年创办以来已举办 7 届，前六届累计签约金额达 780 亿元。 在企业参展方面，拓维信息副总裁、CTO 李曙光此前透露，将在本届大会上集中展示“AI× 鸿蒙”全栈技术成果，并带来一款面向办公场景的全新国产终端产品。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 11 that the Information Office of the Hunan Provincial Government held a press conference announcing that the 2026 World Computing Conference will take place from November 19 to 21 at the Changsha International Conference Center. Themed "Computing for All, Meeting the Future in Hunan — Building a New Form of Intelligent Economy," the event features a "1+5+N+1" format with 21 activities. The core agenda interprets the direction of the computing industry during the 15th Five-Year Plan period and will release research reports on computing industry analysis, computing power trends, and industry standards, along with industrial results in computing-power coordination, infrastructure, and computing hardware and software. Thematic forums cover computing chips, computing-power coordination, AI servers, and embodied intelligence computing, with space computing and marine computing acoustics held for the first time. The opening ceremony and keynote forum are expected to invite Nobel laureates, Chinese and foreign academicians, and leading entrepreneurs to speak on smart manufacturing, semiconductors, artificial intelligence, and computing power. For the first time the event adopts market-based operation, upgrading the previous thematic exhibition to the 2026 Computing Industry Expo, planned at 10,000 square meters with more than 80 domestic and international computing companies expected to exhibit embodied AI robots, brain-computer interfaces, and other products; side events include the Asia-Pacific Robot World Cup Changsha International Invitational and a graduate IC design competition. The World Computing Conference has been held seven times since 2019, with the first six editions signing a cumulative 78 billion yuan. Talkweb Information Vice President and CTO Li Shuguang previously said the company will showcase "AI × HarmonyOS" full-stack results and a new domestic terminal product for office scenarios.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，消息源 @itspdfu 今天（11 月 11 日）在 X 平台发布推文，爆料称在 iOS 27.3 首个开发者预览版 Beta 中， 苹果为 Siri AI 加入了读取“健康”（Health）应用的相关功能 Flag，不过目前均处于禁用状态。 IT之家援引官方支持文档介绍， 当前 Siri AI 尚不支持读取健康 Health 应用数据。 用户可以设置 Siri 访问“健康”应用数据，但 Siri AI 目前尚不支持。 而在 iOS 27.3 首个开发者预览版 Beta 中，苹果公司引入名为“IF / HealthSearch”的功能 Flag，可以将健康信息添加到 Siri 的“查找”工具中，检索范围覆盖 92 种 HealthKit 数据类型，支持查询近期记录和历史摘要。 专门的查询项目包括活动圆环、单次体能训练及训练汇总、睡眠摘要、用药计划与记录，以及新版健康 App 中的“健康年龄”和健康评估。此外，列表还出现了“Readiness”（准备状态），但未包含“Vitals”（生命体征）。 另一项名为“IF / HealthSnippets”的功能 Flag，则涉及查询结果的可视化展示，可为健康统计、活动圆环、训练记录及睡眠摘要提供专门的展示形式。若相关功能最终开放，用户有望直接向 Siri 查询健康记录，并查看更直观的结果，而不必逐项进入健康 App 查找。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 11 that source @itspdfu posted on X the same day that in the first developer beta of iOS 27.3, Apple added flags for Siri AI to read data from the Health app, though all are currently disabled. IT之家 cited Apple's support documentation noting that Siri AI does not currently support reading Health app data: users can set Siri to access Health app data, but Siri AI does not yet support it. In the first iOS 27.3 developer beta, Apple introduced a feature flag called "IF / HealthSearch" that adds health information to Siri's search tool, covering 92 HealthKit data types and supporting queries of recent records and historical summaries. Specific query items include activity rings, individual workouts and workout summaries, sleep summaries, medication schedules and logs, plus "Health Age" and health assessments in the new Health app; a "Readiness" item also appears, but "Vitals" is not included. Another flag, "IF / HealthSnippets," concerns visualizing query results, providing dedicated displays for health statistics, activity rings, workout records, and sleep summaries. If these features ship, users could query health records directly through Siri and see more intuitive results without navigating item by item in the Health app.
items.why_zh: 推测：若相关 Flag 最终开放，Siri 有望成为健康数据的自然语言入口，但目前仅为测试版中的禁用开关，属未经苹果确认的爆料。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the flags eventually ship, Siri could become a natural-language entry point for health data, but for now they are disabled switches in a beta and the claim is unconfirmed by Apple.

items.title_zh: 马斯克 SpaceX 备战太空 AI 算力：锁定 100GW 设备产能，约为 4.4 座三峡电站总装机容量
items.title_en: Report: SpaceX Prepares for Space AI Compute, Locking In 100GW of Equipment Capacity, About 4.4 Three Gorges Dams' Installed Capacity
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）旗下 SpaceX 公司今天（11 月 11 日）发布公告，宣布与德国太阳能电池设备制造商 SINGULUS 签署重大供应合同， 将引进异质结（HJT）太阳能电池整套生产线，从而加速制造 Starmind 卫星。 IT之家注：HJT 全称为 Heterojunction Technology，是一种发电技术，主要结合晶体硅与超薄的非晶硅薄膜，让太阳能电池在接收阳光后，尽量少损失电能、更有效地把电流导出来。 “异质”指的是不同结构的半导体材料。在常见的 HJT 电池中，中间是一片 N 型晶体硅，两面覆盖极薄的非晶硅层，外侧再加上透明导电膜和金属电极。晶体硅和非晶硅虽然都含硅，但原子排列方式不同，因此能够形成“异质结”。 而 Starmind 是 SpaceX 正在推进的太空人工智能计算卫星项目，卫星利用太阳能供电，在太空中运行计算任务，再通过激光链路和星链网络把结果传回地球，其首款公开设计名为 AI1。 根据 SINGULUS 昨日发布的公告，本次合作并非采购现成太阳能电池，主要是制造电池的设备与工艺。SINGULUS 将基于已实现规模化应用的技术，开发高性能太阳能电池及配套生产设备，将湿化学处理、真空镀膜和热处理等工艺用于生产。首条生产线计划于 2027 年上半年交付，双方还计划增加多条产线。 SpaceX 星链业务高级副总裁迈克 · 尼科尔斯表示，此次合作将为得州工厂生产 Starmind 卫星所需太阳能电池提供制造路径，并通过双方的工艺经验与长期投入，为扩大生产建立可持续的供应方案。双方提出，随着卫星制造提速，相关生产将逐步扩大， 以支持超过 100 吉瓦（GW）的生产设备规模。 IT之家注：100 吉瓦就是 1 亿千瓦，是指太阳能电池制造设备所对应的生产规模，并非是 SpaceX 在太空建设的“发电站”。单看功率规模，它约相当于 4.4 座三峡电站（三峡总装机容量为 2,250 万千瓦）的总装机容量。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 11 that, according to reports, SpaceX announced the same day that it signed a major supply contract with German solar cell equipment maker SINGULUS to bring in a full heterojunction (HJT) solar cell production line, accelerating manufacture of Starmind satellites. HJT, or Heterojunction Technology, combines crystalline silicon with ultrathin amorphous silicon films so cells lose less power and conduct current more efficiently; "hetero" refers to different semiconductor structures, and typical HJT cells have N-type crystalline silicon in the middle, ultrathin amorphous silicon layers on both sides, and transparent conductive film plus metal electrodes outside. Starmind is a SpaceX space AI computing satellite project in which satellites are solar-powered, run compute in space, and send results back to Earth via laser links and the Starlink network; its first public design is called AI1. Per SINGULUS's announcement the previous day, the deal is not a purchase of finished solar cells but mainly equipment and processes for making them: SINGULUS will develop high-performance cells and production equipment based on already scaled technology, using wet chemical processing, vacuum coating, and thermal treatment; the first line is planned for delivery in the first half of 2027, with more lines planned. SpaceX Starlink senior vice president Mike Nicolls said the cooperation provides a manufacturing path for solar cells needed for Starmind satellites at the Texas factory and, with combined process expertise and long-term investment, a sustainable supply plan for scaling. The two sides said production will scale as satellite manufacturing speeds up, supporting more than 100 gigawatts (GW) of production equipment capacity. 100 GW equals 100 million kilowatts and refers to the production scale corresponding to solar cell manufacturing equipment, not a "power station" SpaceX would build in space; in power terms it is roughly the total installed capacity of 4.4 Three Gorges Dams (whose total installed capacity is 22.5 million kilowatts).
items.why_zh: 推测：若合同与产能目标兑现，光伏制造设备产能将与太空算力计划绑定，但 100GW 指设备产能而非发电量，且该消息为二手报道，尚待双方正式文件核实。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the contract and capacity targets materialize, solar manufacturing equipment capacity would be tied to a space compute plan, but 100GW refers to equipment capacity rather than power generation, and this is secondhand reporting that still needs confirmation in formal filings.

items.title_zh: 成都第五代贡嘎人形机器人发布，宣称拥有“全球最领先人形机器人大脑核心技术”
items.title_en: Chengdu Unveils Fifth-Generation Genga Humanoid Robot, Claiming 'World's Most Advanced Humanoid Robot Brain Core Technology'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，成都人形机器人创新中心今日发布了 第五代贡嘎人形机器人 ，宣称拥有“全球最领先人形机器人大脑核心技术”。 作为成都人形机器人创新中心具身智能大脑技术的集大成之作，五代贡嘎搭载自研一体化具身智能系统，在场景感知、时空记忆、因果推理规划、动作世界模型等核心模块完成系统性迭代， 宣称“代表当前全球第一梯队的人形机器人大脑技术最高水平” 。 五代贡嘎的具身大脑打通了 “结构化感知 — 时空记忆 — 因果规划 — 动作推演 — 执行反馈” 完整技术链路，实现环境认知、记忆更新、任务规划与操作执行的端到端协同。 在环境感知维度，机器人融合 RGB 视觉、深度信息与本体位姿数据，构建层次化三维场景图。依托跨视角实体关联、语义关系建模与增量式场景更新机制，持续对动态家庭空间做结构化表征，能够稳定识别物品位置、类别、摆放关系，适应居家环境里物品移位、杂物新增这类高频变化。 在记忆体系上，创新中心自研的物理时空记忆引擎，将空间坐标、物体物理状态、时间演化规律、历史交互经验统一存储管理。机器人可以长期维护物体身份一致性，支持时序记忆检索、多轮记忆对齐与冲突自动消解；简单来说， 它能“记住”东西之前放在哪里、什么时候被挪动过、过往操作的成败经验 ，摆脱传统机器人单次任务无记忆的短板，支撑跨时长、分多天的长程家庭任务。 决策规划模块引入因果关联推理框架，不再只依靠数据统计关联做动作选择。系统自动解析任务内的因果依赖、动作前置条件、预期执行效果以及机器人自身资源约束，自主完成层次化任务拆解；当环境突发变动、任务受阻时可实时动态重规划， 遇到意外情况自主判断、调整方案，而不是简单停止任务 。 动作执行层面是五代贡嘎的核心亮点 ：搭载潜空间动作条件世界模型。机器人可以提前做多步未来状态预测、候选动作仿真推演、不确定性风险评估，在虚拟空间先预判不同操作的结果；再结合运动轨迹优化与闭环预测控制，实时修正操作偏差，大幅提升抓取、归置、擦拭这类精细家用操作的成功率，降低碰撞、物品掉落等失误。 IT之家注：成都人形机器人创新中心全称为成都人形机器人创新中心有限公司，2024 年 4 月 11 日成立，是四川省“一号创新工程”首个原点项目及中西部首个人形机器人创新中心。
items.summary_en: ITHome, November 11: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center today released the fifth-generation Genga humanoid robot, claiming it possesses 'the world's most advanced humanoid robot brain core technology.' Described as the culmination of the center's embodied-intelligence brain work, the fifth-generation Genga carries a self-developed integrated embodied intelligence system, with systematic iteration across core modules including scene perception, spatiotemporal memory, causal reasoning and planning, and action world models; it is claimed to 'represent the highest level of humanoid robot brain technology in the current global first tier.' Its embodied brain connects a full chain of 'structured perception — spatiotemporal memory — causal planning — action simulation — execution feedback,' enabling end-to-end coordination of environmental cognition, memory updating, task planning and manipulation execution. On environmental perception, the robot fuses RGB vision, depth information and body pose data to build hierarchical 3D scene graphs; through cross-view entity association, semantic relationship modeling and incremental scene updating, it continuously represents dynamic home spaces structurally, reliably identifying object locations, categories and placement relationships, and adapting to frequent changes such as moved items and newly added clutter. For memory, the center's self-developed physical spatiotemporal memory engine stores and manages spatial coordinates, object physical states, temporal evolution patterns and historical interaction experience in a unified way; the robot can maintain object identity consistency over time and supports temporal memory retrieval, multi-round memory alignment and automatic conflict resolution. In short, it can 'remember' where things were placed, when they were moved and whether past operations succeeded or failed, overcoming the no-memory limitation of single-task traditional robots and supporting long-horizon, multi-day household tasks. The decision-making module introduces a causal reasoning framework rather than relying only on statistical correlations for action selection; the system parses causal dependencies within tasks, action preconditions, expected effects and the robot's own resource constraints, and autonomously performs hierarchical task decomposition; when the environment changes suddenly or a task is blocked, it can replan dynamically in real time and judge and adjust on its own instead of simply stopping. Action execution is the core highlight: equipped with a latent-space action-conditioned world model, the robot can predict multiple future states, simulate candidate actions and assess uncertainty risk in advance, judging the outcomes of different operations in virtual space; combined with trajectory optimization and closed-loop predictive control, it corrects deviations in real time, greatly improving success rates for fine household operations such as grasping, tidying and wiping while reducing collisions and dropped items. ITHome notes: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center Co., Ltd. was founded on April 11, 2024, and is the first origin project of Sichuan Province's 'No. 1 Innovation Project' and the first humanoid robot innovation center in central and western China.
items.why_zh: 推测：这些性能表述均来自发布方自身，尚无第三方评测佐证，其“全球最领先”说法需待独立验证。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，成都人形机器人创新中心今日发布了 第五代贡嘎人形机器人 ，宣称拥有“全球最领先人形机器人大脑核心技术”。 作为成都人形机器人创新中心具身智能大脑技术的集大成之作，五代贡嘎搭载自研一体化具身智能系统，在场景感知、时空记忆、因果推理规划、动作世界模型等核心模块完成系统性迭代， 宣称“代表当前全球第一梯队的人形机器人大脑技术最高水平” 。 五代贡嘎的具身大脑打通了 “结构化感知 — 时空记忆 — 因果规划 — 动作推演 — 执行反馈” 完整技术链路，实现环境认知、记忆更新、任务规划与操作执行的端到端协同。 在环境感知维度，机器人融合 RGB 视觉、深度信息与本体位姿数据，构建层次化三维场景图。依托跨视角实体关联、语义关系建模与增量式场景更新机制，持续对动态家庭空间做结构化表征，能够稳定识别物品位置、类别、摆放关系，适应居家环境里物品移位、杂物新增这类高频变化。 在记忆体系上，创新中心自研的物理时空记忆引擎，将空间坐标、物体物理状态、时间演化规律、历史交互经验统一存储管理。机器人可以长期维护物体身份一致性，支持时序记忆检索、多轮记忆对齐与冲突自动消解；简单来说， 它能“记住”东西之前放在哪里、什么时候被挪动过、过往操作的成败经验 ，摆脱传统机器人单次任务无记忆的短板，支撑跨时长、分多天的长程家庭任务。 决策规划模块引入因果关联推理框架，不再只依靠数据统计关联做动作选择。系统自动解析任务内的因果依赖、动作前置条件、预期执行效果以及机器人自身资源约束，自主完成层次化任务拆解；当环境突发变动、任务受阻时可实时动态重规划， 遇到意外情况自主判断、调整方案，而不是简单停止任务 。 动作执行层面是五代贡嘎的核心亮点 ：搭载潜空间动作条件世界模型。机器人可以提前做多步未来状态预测、候选动作仿真推演、不确定性风险评估，在虚拟空间先预判不同操作的结果；再结合运动轨迹优化与闭环预测控制，实时修正操作偏差，大幅提升抓取、归置、擦拭这类精细家用操作的成功率，降低碰撞、物品掉落等失误。 IT之家注：成都人形机器人创新中心全称为成都人形机器人创新中心有限公司，2024 年 4 月 11 日成立，是四川省“一号创新工程”首个原点项目及中西部首个人形机器人创新中心。

items.title_zh: Arm 发布 Cortex-M42 处理器：向量算力最高达前代 3 倍，让更多小型设备用上本地 AI
items.title_en: Arm Launches Cortex-M42 Processor: Up to 3x Vector Compute of Predecessor, Bringing On-Device AI to More Small Devices
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息， Arm 昨日（11 月 10 日）发布公告，宣布推出 Cortex-M42 处理器 ，并将其纳入 Flexible Access 和 Total Access 两项技术授权计划。 定位方面，Cortex-M42 处理器主要面向对成本和芯片面积敏感的智能终端，目标为可穿戴设备、工业控制器等产品带来更强的机器学习与数字信号处理能力。 架构方面，Cortex-M42 处理器采用基于 Armv8.1-M 架构，结合 Helium 技术与紧凑的 AHB 总线设计，方便芯片厂商升级现有的 Cortex-M4、Cortex-M33 微控制器方案。 Helium 是一套用于 Cortex-M 处理器的向量扩展技术，让同一个 CPU 既能执行控制代码，也能更高效地处理适合向量化的数据运算。 性能方面，相比较 Cortex-M33，最新 Cortex-M42 处理器向量计算能力最高可达 3 倍，向量计算能效最高可达 2 倍。IT之家注：向量计算是指让处理器用一条指令，对一组数据执行同一种运算，主要通过 SIMD（单指令、多数据）提高数据处理效率。SIMD 把多个数据元素放进较大的寄存器中，每个元素所在的位置称为一个“通道”，然后对多个通道执行相同操作。 在实际应用中，新处理器可用于可穿戴设备的音频处理和关键词识别，也可承担工业设备的传感器分析与状态监测。Arm 还举例称，它可在机器人电机、关节附近处理信号，帮助发现异常或磨损迹象。 此次发布也扩充了 Arm 的技术授权组合。截至 2026 年 11 月，Flexible Access 拥有 319 家活跃成员，已促成超过 500 个独立流片项目；Total Access 拥有 60 家合作伙伴，累计支持超过 600 个项目。Arm 希望通过扩大技术获取渠道，推动更多设备在本地完成智能处理。
items.summary_en: ITHome, November 11: Arm announced yesterday (November 10) the launch of the Cortex-M42 processor and its inclusion in the Flexible Access and Total Access licensing programs. Cortex-M42 targets cost- and die-area-sensitive intelligent terminals, aiming to bring stronger machine learning and digital signal processing to products such as wearables and industrial controllers. Architecturally it is based on Armv8.1-M, combining Helium technology with a compact AHB bus design to ease upgrades from existing Cortex-M4 and Cortex-M33 microcontroller designs. Helium is a vector extension for Cortex-M processors that lets a single CPU both run control code and more efficiently handle vectorizable data operations. In performance, vector compute capability is up to 3x that of Cortex-M33, with up to 2x vector compute energy efficiency. ITHome notes: vector computing lets a processor apply one instruction to a group of data, mainly via SIMD (single instruction, multiple data), placing multiple data elements in wider registers where each element position is a 'lane' and the same operation runs across lanes. In practice the new processor can handle audio processing and keyword spotting in wearables and sensor analysis and condition monitoring in industrial equipment. Arm also cites processing signals near robot motors and joints to help detect anomalies or signs of wear. The launch also expands Arm's licensing portfolio: as of November 2026, Flexible Access has 319 active members and has enabled more than 500 discrete tape-outs, while Total Access has 60 partners and has supported over 600 projects cumulatively. Arm hopes broader technology access will push more devices to handle intelligence locally.
items.why_zh: 推测：若向量性能与能效提升如 Arm 所述，将降低在可穿戴与工业设备上运行本地 AI 的门槛，但实际表现取决于具体芯片实现。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the vector performance and efficiency gains are as Arm describes, they could lower the barrier to running on-device AI in wearables and industrial devices, though real-world results depend on specific chip implementations.

items.title_zh: 微软正式发布 .NET 11：开发更省时，AI 工具更齐全
items.title_en: Microsoft Officially Releases .NET 11: Faster Development, More Complete AI Tooling
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，昨日（11 月 10 日）召开的.NET Conf 2026 线上大会上， 微软正式发布 .NET 11，围绕运行性能、开发效率及 AI 应用构建推出一系列更新，覆盖网页、移动端和桌面应用开发。 IT之家注：.NET 是由微软支持、与开源社区共同维护的软件开发平台。它免费、开源，开发者可以用它构建网站后台、桌面软件、手机应用、云服务等多种程序。 本次 .NET 11 围绕性能、AI 应用及跨平台开发展开升级，涵盖 C# 15、网站开发框架 ASP.NET Core 和跨平台框架.NET MAUI 等，从而减少开发等待时间，简化现代应用构建流程。 性能方面，新版带来数百项运行时与基础库优化，并通过原生编译的命令行入口、保持预热的构建服务，减少工具反复启动的开销。 AI 方面，.NET 11 开发工具包内置 MCP 服务器模板，方便开发者将应用功能接入 AI 工具调用体系。配套 AI 库与智能体框架支持模型接入、工具调用和工作流编排；Blazor 还推出实验性 AI 界面组件，可用于流式聊天、工具展示与操作审批。 编程体验上，C# 15 新增联合类型，让程序能够明确列出一项操作的不同结果，并由编译器检查是否遗漏处理。跨平台开发方面，.NET MAUI 默认采用 CoreCLR 运行时，同时改进界面调试与测试；Windows Forms 则提供可选的现代视觉样式。 .NET 11 属于标准支持版本，提供两年支持，.NET 10 仍是长期支持选项。微软提醒，升级前应检查兼容性、依赖项和硬件要求，并以实际测试验证效果。 参考 Announcing .NET 11
items.summary_en: ITHome, November 11: At the .NET Conf 2026 online event yesterday (November 10), Microsoft officially released .NET 11, with a series of updates around runtime performance, developer productivity and AI application building, covering web, mobile and desktop development. ITHome notes: .NET is a software development platform supported by Microsoft and maintained with the open source community; it is free and open source, and developers use it to build website backends, desktop software, mobile apps, cloud services and more. .NET 11 upgrades center on performance, AI applications and cross-platform development, covering C# 15, the ASP.NET Core web framework and the .NET MAUI cross-platform framework, aiming to cut development wait times and simplify building modern apps. On performance, the release brings hundreds of runtime and base library optimizations and reduces repeated tool startup overhead through a native-compiled command-line entry point and a warm-kept build service. On AI, the .NET 11 SDK includes an MCP server template to help developers connect app features to AI tool-calling systems; companion AI libraries and agent frameworks support model integration, tool calling and workflow orchestration; Blazor adds experimental AI UI components for streaming chat, tool display and action approval. On the programming experience, C# 15 adds union types, letting programs explicitly list the different outcomes of an operation with compiler checks for missed handling. On cross-platform development, .NET MAUI uses the CoreCLR runtime by default and improves UI debugging and testing, while Windows Forms offers an optional modern visual style. .NET 11 is a standard-term support release with two years of support; .NET 10 remains the long-term support option. Microsoft advises checking compatibility, dependencies and hardware requirements before upgrading, and verifying results with actual testing.

items.title_en: Google Updates Its Android AI Development Benchmark: Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Scores Revealed
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，谷歌官方账号 Android Developers（@AndroidDev）昨日（11 月 10 日）在 X 平台发布推文， 首次公开了 OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra、Kimi K3.1 Pro 以及 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 三款模型的 Android Bench 基准跑分。 IT之家注：Android Bench 是 Google 面向 Android 开发场景推出的 AI 编程基准，重点考察模型完成应用创建、功能开发、代码迁移和应用转换等真实工程任务的能力。 本次新增的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 使用 kimi-code 智能体，在 30 项长程任务中获得 24.0% 的通过率，平均完成度为 82.3%，平均耗时 27.4 小时，单次基准运行成本为 317.4 美元 （现汇率约合 2,123 元人民币） 。 从横向对比看，Kimi K3.1 Pro 的成绩高于 GPT 6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Gemini 4 Argon，但低于 GPT 6.1 Terra 的 28.7%。 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 通过 opencode 智能体参与评测，取得 17.3% 的通过率、71.2% 的平均完成度、12.0 小时的平均耗时，以及 9.9 美元 （现汇率约合 66.2 元人民币） 的单次基准运行成本。虽然其通过率低于 Kimi K3.1 Pro，但其速度和成本优势明显，尤其适合对预算、响应时间敏感的开发团队。
items.summary_en: ITHome, November 11: Google's official Android Developers account (@AndroidDev) posted on X yesterday (November 10), disclosing for the first time Android Bench scores for three models: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra, Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. ITHome notes: Android Bench is Google's AI coding benchmark for Android development scenarios, focused on whether models can complete real engineering tasks such as app creation, feature development, code migration and app conversion. The newly added Kimi K3.1 Pro, using the kimi-code agent, achieved a 24.0% pass rate across 30 long-horizon tasks, with 82.3% average completion, 27.4 hours average duration and a per-run benchmark cost of 317.4 US dollars (about 2,123 yuan at current exchange rates). In comparison, Kimi K3.1 Pro scored higher than GPT 6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1 and Gemini 4 Argon, but lower than GPT 6.1 Terra's 28.7%. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, evaluated via the opencode agent, achieved a 17.3% pass rate, 71.2% average completion, 12.0 hours average duration and a per-run benchmark cost of 9.9 US dollars (about 66.2 yuan). Although its pass rate is lower than Kimi K3.1 Pro's, its speed and cost advantages are clear, making it especially suited to development teams sensitive to budget and response time.
items.why_zh: 推测：厂商自建的开发场景基准首次横向公开多款模型的通过率与成本数据，可能影响 Android 开发者的模型选型，但单一基准与厂商自述结果不宜视为独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: a vendor-run development benchmark disclosing pass rates and costs for multiple models side by side may influence Android developers' model choices, though a single vendor-reported benchmark should not be treated as independent verification.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，KORA Systems 昨日（11 月 10 日）发布公告， 宣布推出全新操作系统 KORA OS，宣称这是首个“自下而上”专为 AI PC 设计的操作系统。 不同于在传统系统上叠加 AI 助手，KORA OS 在系统底层直接融入智能体工作流、上下文记忆和本地 AI 推理， 目标让电脑从“打开应用完成操作”转向“表达意图、由 AI 协助完成”。 底层方面，KORA OS 基于 NixOS 构建，引入“神经工作区”和新型文件系统。用户可按任务目标组织工作空间，系统则围绕意图、上下文与记忆管理文件，系统依然会保留传统文件夹和桌面应用，但不再是系统核心。 在 AI 能力方面，KORA 采用自研 Cortex 推理引擎，可调度 CPU、GPU 和 NPU 等硬件资源，支持开放权重模型在本地运行。其内置 Lemma 推理引擎基于 llama.cpp ，用于提升推理效率；系统还会判断任务应交由云端处理，还是保留在设备本地。 隐私方面，KORA 表示，工作流的记忆与上下文将保留在用户桌面设备上，不会离开本机。官方表示为了降低 AI 自动操作带来的安全风险，每个工作区均在隔离沙箱中运行，应用和 AI 智能体拥有独立权限。IT之家附上相关图片如下： 兼容性方面，KORA 内置基于 Wine 和 Proton 的 Windows 应用转换层，并由本地 AI 模型协助完成应用配置。该公司正与高通合作，骁龙 X2 Elite 有望成为首款支持 KORA OS 的 PC 平台；系统同时计划支持 AMD、Intel 等 x86 芯片，并逐步扩展至其他 Arm 架构设备。 KORA 还在为与企业方 HUMAIN 联合开发的企业版 HUMAIN OS 打造基础层，该版本预计于 2027 年发布。创始团队曾参与 Cyanogen、Android 和 GameOS 项目，目前约有 20 名工程师参与研发。
items.summary_en: ITHome, November 11: KORA Systems announced yesterday (November 10) a new operating system, KORA OS, described as the first OS designed 'from the ground up' for AI PCs. Rather than layering an AI assistant on a traditional system, KORA OS builds agent workflows, contextual memory and local AI inference directly into the system's foundations, aiming to shift PCs from 'open an app and complete a task' to 'state an intent and let AI help complete it.' Under the hood, KORA OS is built on NixOS and introduces 'neural workspaces' and a new file system; users can organize workspaces by task goal while the system manages files around intent, context and memory — traditional folders and desktop apps remain but are no longer the system's core. On AI, KORA uses a self-developed Cortex inference engine that can schedule CPU, GPU and NPU resources and supports running open-weight models locally; its built-in Lemma inference engine, based on llama.cpp, is meant to improve inference efficiency; the system also decides whether a task should go to the cloud or stay on the device. On privacy, KORA says workflow memory and context stay on the user's desktop and never leave the machine; to reduce security risks from autonomous AI actions, each workspace runs in an isolated sandbox with separate permissions for apps and AI agents. For compatibility, KORA includes a Windows application translation layer based on Wine and Proton, with a local AI model helping configure apps. The company is working with Qualcomm, and Snapdragon X2 Elite is expected to be the first PC platform supporting KORA OS; the system also plans to support AMD and Intel x86 chips and gradually expand to other Arm devices. KORA is also building the foundation layer for an enterprise edition, HUMAIN OS, co-developed with enterprise partner HUMAIN, expected in 2027. The founding team previously worked on Cyanogen, Android and GameOS projects, and about 20 engineers are currently involved in development.
items.why_zh: 推测：这是尚无大规模验证的新系统，其宣称的原生 AI 架构能否在应用生态与芯片适配层面落地仍需观察。
items.why_en: Speculation: this is a new, not-yet-broadly-validated system, and whether its claimed AI-native architecture holds up on app ecosystem and chip support remains to be seen.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 七名联合创始人拟在 IPO 中各套现 2.5 亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic's Seven Co-Founders to Sell About $250 Million Each in IPO
items.summary_zh: 11 月 11 日，据 TechCrunch 报道，Anthropic 当地时间 11 月 10 日更新招股书，披露七名联合创始人均计划在公司首次公开募股中出售 337.84 万股。 按照每股 74 美元的发行价区间中值计算，每人可套现约 2.5 亿美元，七人合计出售股票价值约 17.5 亿美元。 Anthropic 此次给出的发行价区间为每股 70 美元至 78 美元。按此计算，每名创始人出售股票对应的金额约为 2.36 亿美元至 2.64 亿美元，最终所得将取决于实际发行价。七人合计出售 2364.86 万股，占本次由现有股东出售股份的全部份额。 参与出售的创始人包括 CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫迪、总裁丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪，以及汤姆 · 布朗、杰克 · 克拉克、贾里德 · 卡普兰、萨姆 · 麦坎德利什和克里斯托弗 · 奥拉。此次出售约占每人原持股数量的 1.4%。交易完成后，每人仍将持有约 2.37 亿至 2.40 亿股 A 类股票，按 74 美元计算，剩余持股价值接近 180 亿美元。 招股书显示，Anthropic 计划在此次 IPO 中发行 8.25 亿股 A 类股票，其中公司发行约 8.01 亿股，其余由七名创始人出售。发行价最高达到 78 美元时，公司完全摊薄估值可能达到 1.404 万亿美元。Anthropic 已申请以“ANT”为股票代码在纳斯达克上市。 尽管出售部分持股，七名创始人仍将通过共同组建的 Founder LLC 掌握公司控制权。IPO 完成前，Anthropic 将向该实体发行一股不具备经济权益的 F 类特殊股票，使其在一般股东表决事项中拥有 50.1% 的投票权。与此同时，Anthropic 长期利益信托将继续负责选举董事会多数成员。 相关阅读： 《 Anthropic 发布 IPO 路演视频正式启动最高 643.5 亿美元募资计划，估值约在 1~1.4 万亿美元 》
items.summary_en: November 11 (TechCrunch): Anthropic updated its prospectus on November 10 local time, disclosing that all seven co-founders plan to sell 3,378,400 shares each in the company's IPO. At the $74 midpoint of the offering range, each would cash out about $250 million, with the seven selling roughly $1.75 billion in shares combined. The offering price range is $70 to $78 per share, implying each founder's sale is worth about $236 million to $264 million depending on the final price. Together the seven are selling 23,648,600 shares, the entire tranche being sold by existing shareholders. The selling founders are CEO Dario Amodei, President Daniela Amodei, and Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish and Christopher Olah. The sale represents about 1.4% of each person's original holdings. After the transaction each will still hold roughly 237 million to 240 million Class A shares, worth close to $18 billion at $74. The prospectus shows Anthropic plans to issue 825 million Class A shares in the IPO, about 801 million from the company and the rest from the seven founders. At the top price of $78, the company's fully diluted valuation could reach $1.404 trillion. Anthropic has applied to list on Nasdaq under the ticker 'ANT.' Despite selling some shares, the seven founders will retain control through a jointly formed Founder LLC. Before the IPO closes, Anthropic will issue that entity one non-economic Class F special share giving it 50.1% voting power on ordinary shareholder matters, while the Anthropic Long-Term Benefit Trust will continue to elect a majority of the board.
items.why_zh: 推测：创始人小额减持同时保留控制权的安排，可能成为观察 Anthropic 上市后治理结构的关键点，但相关条款仍以最终招股文件为准。
items.why_en: Speculation: the arrangement of modest founder selling alongside retained control may become a key lens on Anthropic's post-IPO governance, though the terms remain subject to final filings.

items.title_en: Anthropic Launches IPO Roadshow, Seeking Up to $64.35 Billion
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，当地时间 11 月 10 日，Anthropic 正式宣布启动首次公开募股（IPO）路演，并公布股票发行计划。 根据公告，Anthropic 此次拟发行 8.25 亿股 A 类普通股，发行价格区间为每股 70 至 78 美元。按照发行价上限计算，本次基础发行规模最高约为 643.5 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,302.82 亿元人民币） 。 根据 Anthropic 官方披露的发行安排，此次发行的 8.25 亿股股票中，有 8.01351354 亿股由 Anthropic 自身发行，另外 2364.8646 万股由部分现有股东出售。Anthropic 不会从现有股东出售股票所得款项中获得收益。 此外，Anthropic 预计授予承销商一项为期 30 天的额外购股选择权，允许承销商额外购买最多 1.2375 亿股 A 类普通股。若该选择权全部行使，实际发行股份数量和募资规模还将进一步增加。 Anthropic 已申请将 A 类普通股以股票代码「ANT」在纳斯达克全球精选市场挂牌交易。公司表示，相关证券注册声明已经提交 SEC，但尚未生效。在注册声明生效之前，相关股票不能出售。 路透社进一步报道称，Anthropic 此次 IPO 还将配合一项独立的私募配售交易，计划向包括谷歌、英伟达、AMD、博通、美光、微软和台积电在内的投资方发行价值 260 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,738.51 亿元人民币） 的 N 类普通股。若将 IPO 和这项私募配售合并计算，相关融资规模最高可达 904 亿美元 （现汇率约合 6,044.67 亿元人民币） 。 估值方面，路透社报道称，按照发行价区间上限计算，Anthropic 完全稀释后的估值约为 1.4 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 9.36 万亿元人民币） ；如果不计入股票期权和限制性股票等潜在股份，估值约为 1 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 6.69 万亿元人民币） 。高盛和摩根士丹利担任此次 IPO 的主要承销商。 相关阅读： 《 高盛预计 Anthropic 2030 年营收突破 6000 亿美元，并跻身全球营收最高企业之列 》 《 Anthropic IPO 每股定价区间 70-78 美元，剑指 1.4 万亿美元完全摊薄估值 》 《 曝 Anthropic 拟通过 IPO 筹集最多 644 亿美元，上市推介启动在即 》 《 消息称 Anthropic 计划通过 IPO 募集至多 693 亿美元资金，规模锁定历史前二 》
items.summary_en: IT Home reported that on Nov. 10 local time, Anthropic announced the launch of its IPO roadshow and offering plan: it plans to sell 825 million Class A ordinary shares at $70–$78 each, implying a base offering of up to about $64.35 billion at the top of the range. Of the shares, 801,351,354 will be issued by the company and 23,648,646 sold by existing shareholders, with Anthropic receiving no proceeds from the shareholder sale; underwriters get a 30-day option to buy up to 123.75 million additional shares. Anthropic applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under “ANT”; its registration statement has been filed with the SEC but is not yet effective. Reuters reported a concurrent $26 billion private placement of Class N shares to Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC, bringing total fundraising to up to $90.4 billion; at the top price, the fully diluted valuation is about $1.4 trillion, or about $1 trillion excluding options and restricted stock, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as lead underwriters.
items.why_zh: 若按报道完成，这将是史上最大 IPO 之一，并凸显前沿 AI 公司对资本的巨额需求；相关估值与条款来自媒体报道，仍需 SEC 文件最终确认（推测）。
items.why_en: If completed as reported, this would be one of the largest IPOs ever and highlight frontier AI companies' enormous capital needs; the valuation and terms come from media reports and still require SEC filings for final confirmation (speculative).

items.title_zh: OpenAI 扩展 ChatGPT 商业功能：企业可认领资料并创建 AI 智能体，为 Business Agent 投放广告
items.title_en: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT for Businesses With Merchant Profiles, AI Agents and Sponsored Placements
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，当地时间 11 月 10 日，OpenAI 宣布推出 ChatGPT Businesses 测试版，为企业提供商家信息认领、资料管理、用户互动数据分析以及 AI 智能体等服务，帮助企业通过 ChatGPT 接触潜在客户。 OpenAI 表示，目前全球每周有 12 亿人使用 ChatGPT。Businesses 功能将通过 Business Hub 提供，企业可以在其中认领自己在 ChatGPT 中的商家资料，并在完成身份验证后更新关键信息，还可以添加包含产品价格和库存情况的自助式产品数据源，让 ChatGPT 能够向用户提供更加准确、及时的商品和服务信息。 符合条件、所在地区支持 ChatGPT 的企业均可通过 Business Hub 认领商家资料。现有 OpenAI Enterprise 客户和广告客户可以联系 OpenAI 客户代表办理。Shopify 商家则可以通过 Business Hub 或 Shopify 管理后台连接店铺，以简化验证流程。符合条件的 Shopify 商品此前已经通过 Shopify Catalog 集成到 ChatGPT。 在用户互动数据方面，Business Hub 将向企业提供汇总统计信息，包括商家在 ChatGPT 中被提及的次数、用户点击商家网站的次数，以及用户通过哪些常见话题发现相关企业。这些数据旨在帮助企业了解自身在 ChatGPT 中的展示情况，并据此完善提供给平台的信息。 OpenAI 强调，相关数据分析功能经过隐私保护设计，不会向企业分享用户与 ChatGPT 的对话内容，也不会分享用户与 Business Agent 的聊天记录。只有当对话或互动数量达到一定门槛时，企业才能查看相应的汇总数据。 此次发布的另一项重点功能是 Business Agent。企业认领商家资料后，符合条件的组织可以创建、测试并发布自己的 Business Agent，用于回答用户问题、介绍产品和服务。 当企业出现在 ChatGPT 的模型回答中时，用户可以点击查看该企业的 ChatGPT 资料页面。如果企业提供了 Business Agent，用户还可以主动开启与该智能体的对话，例如询问两款商品之间的区别，以及哪些功能更符合自身需求。 OpenAI 表示，Business Agent 的对话会明确标注身份，与用户原本和 ChatGPT 的对话相互独立，也会与 ChatGPT 自身提供的独立回答区分开来。 此外，企业还可以为自己的 Business Agent 购买“赞助展示位置”，并将其设置为 ChatGPT 广告的落地目标。OpenAI 称，赞助内容会明确标注，并与 ChatGPT 的普通回答分开呈现。 目前，Business Agent 已面向美国符合条件的电子商务企业和在线服务企业开放。OpenAI 计划逐步将 Businesses 和 Business Agent 扩展至更多市场及行业，并继续为具有复杂需求的组织开发相关工具。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported that on Nov. 10 local time, OpenAI launched a beta of ChatGPT Businesses, offering through Business Hub the ability for companies to claim their merchant profiles in ChatGPT, verify their identity and update key information, and add self-serve product feeds with prices and inventory. Business Hub provides aggregate analytics such as how often a merchant is mentioned, clicks to its website and the common topics through which users discover it, but it does not share user conversations or Business Agent chats, and data is shown only after interaction thresholds are met. Eligible companies can create, test and publish Business Agents to answer user questions; users can start a chat from the company's profile page, and that chat is clearly labeled and separate from ordinary ChatGPT conversations. Companies can also buy “sponsored placements” for their Business Agents and use them as ad landing targets; sponsored content is clearly labeled. Business Agents are currently available to eligible U.S. e-commerce and online services companies, with OpenAI planning to expand to more markets and industries. OpenAI says ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users.
items.why_zh: OpenAI 正把 ChatGPT 变成企业发现、客服与广告的新入口，可能重塑搜索与商家流量分配；实际效果与隐私边界仍待观察（推测）。
items.why_en: OpenAI is turning ChatGPT into a new entry point for business discovery, customer service and advertising, potentially reshaping search and merchant traffic; the actual effects and privacy boundaries remain to be seen (speculative).

items.title_zh: 谷歌联合 Artificial Analysis 推出 MKA 基准测试：Gemini 4 Carbon 多模态知识工作测试获第二，任务成本仅为第一名六分之一
items.title_en: Google and Artificial Analysis Launch MKA Benchmark; Gemini 4 Carbon Ranks Second at One-Sixth the Cost
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，当地时间 11 月 10 日，谷歌宣布联合 AI 模型评测机构 Artificial Analysis 推出多模态知识智能体基准测试 MKA（Multimodal Knowledge Agent），用于评估 AI 智能体处理视觉复杂文件、完成现实世界知识工作任务的能力。 谷歌表示，其最新发布的 Gemini 4 Carbon 在该测试中取得了参测模型第二名的成绩，完成任务的平均成本仅为排名第一模型的约六分之一。 谷歌 DeepMind 高级产品经理 Rohan Doshi 和首席工程师 Ben Caine 介绍称，现有不少知识工作基准测试仅依赖文本即可完成，而现实工作往往涉及大量视觉信息。例如，建筑师需要交叉核对建筑蓝图，工程师需要分析工程示意图，专业人员还需要将不同来源的信息整理成演示文稿、报告和电子表格。 MKA 基准测试旨在评估 AI 智能体在这些复杂工作场景中的表现。谷歌与来自 10 个行业、83 种职业的领域专家合作，建立了包含 200 项任务的评测集，覆盖商业、建筑、教育、工程、金融、医疗、法律与政府、物流与地图、科学以及软件与数据等领域。 每项任务都模拟一个多步骤专业项目，包含真实工作提示词以及一组多模态输入文件。谷歌称，这些任务通常需要经验丰富的专业人员花费 3 至 8 小时完成。IT之家注意到，每项任务还配有专家编写的评分标准，平均包含约 70 项是非判断检查项，其中事实准确性占 75%，视觉设计占 25%。 在评测机制方面，所有参测模型均运行于相同的开源智能体框架 Stirrup，使用相同工具、沙箱环境和交互轮次预算。最终交付成果由一个基于非谷歌模型构建的智能体评审系统进行评分，该系统会打开所有文件、渲染页面、检查电子表格公式，并按照专家评分标准核验结果。谷歌表示，领域专家对模型输出进行人工评分时，与自动评审系统的结果一致率达到 96%。 为避免测试题泄露并进入模型训练数据，Artificial Analysis 将 200 项正式评测任务设为私有。同时，项目还在 Hugging Face 上公开了另外 10 项任务，供开发者了解测试格式并评估自己的智能体。 谷歌公布的测试结果显示，Gemini 4 Carbon 在参测模型中取得质量排名第二的成绩，但平均任务成本仅为排名第一模型的六分之一。谷歌还指出，不同模型完成同一批任务时的效率存在明显差异，平均每项任务消耗的交互轮次在 30 至 130 轮之间。 目前，MKA 基准测试已通过 Artificial Analysis 开放，开发者可以使用该平台评估自己的模型。Gemini 4 Carbon 则已通过 Gemini API 在 Google AI Studio 中提供。 相关阅读： 《 谷歌迄今最强模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 登场：主打复杂编程、科学研究与网络安全 》 《 谷歌最强 AI 模型：Gemini 4 Carbon 登顶全球智能指数榜首，“专职”做网络安全 》
items.summary_en: IT Home reported that on Nov. 10 local time, Google and Artificial Analysis launched MKA, a multimodal knowledge agent benchmark for evaluating AI agents on visually complex documents and real-world knowledge-work tasks. Google said Gemini 4 Carbon ranked second among participating models on quality, at about one-sixth the average task cost of the top-ranked model. MKA was built with experts from 10 industries and 83 occupations and contains 200 tasks covering business, architecture, education, engineering, finance, healthcare, law and government, logistics and maps, science, and software and data; each task simulates a multi-step professional project, typically requiring 3–8 hours for experts, with rubrics averaging about 70 binary checks, 75% for factual accuracy and 25% for visual design. All models run on the same open-source agent framework, Stirrup, with the same tools, sandbox and interaction-turn budget; the judge system is built on a non-Google model, and expert human scoring agreed with the automated judge 96% of the time. The 200 official tasks are private, while 10 additional tasks are public on Hugging Face; models used 30–130 turns on average for the same task set.
items.why_zh: 该基准试图用视觉密集、长流程的专业任务衡量智能体，可能推动评测从文本问答转向真实工作产出；排名与成本数据由谷歌公布，尚待独立复现（推测）。
items.why_en: The benchmark aims to measure agents on visually intensive, long-horizon professional tasks and could push evaluation from text Q&A toward real work outputs; the ranking and cost figures were published by Google and have yet to be independently reproduced (speculative).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，当地时间 11 月 10 日，谷歌宣布正式开放 Gemini 4 Carbon 模型，面向开发者、企业、科研人员和消费者提供服务。 谷歌高级副总裁、DeepMind 首席 AI 架构师 Koray Kavukcuoglu 介绍称，该模型是谷歌目前能力最强的推理模型，重点面向复杂软件工程、多步骤智能体任务、科学研究和网络安全等场景。 Gemini 4 Carbon 于 10 月 28 日首次公布，此前通过 Fairwind Program（网络安全合作计划）向部分网络安全防御人员开放。此次则进一步扩大使用范围。 谷歌称，相较于同期推出的 Gemini 4 Argon，Carbon 能够在复杂任务中投入更多推理 Token，进行假设探索、结果验证和边缘情况检查，更适合多步骤编码、复杂调试以及开放式科学研究。 在开发者工具方面，Gemini 4 Carbon 已通过 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 向付费开发者开放，同时面向企业客户提供服务。模型也正在向 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户逐步开放，覆盖 Google Antigravity、Gemini 应用和 Google 搜索中的 AI 模式。 根据 Google AI Studio 官方文档，Gemini 4 Carbon 的模型 ID 为 gemini-4-carbon ，支持文本、图像、视频、音频和 PDF 输入，输出为文本。 该模型拥有 1,048,576 Token 的统一上下文窗口，标准同步请求的最大输出为 65,536 Token，通过 Long Decode（长文本解码）机制，最大输出可扩展至 1,048,576 Token。模型还支持 low、medium、high 三档推理强度。 价格方面，Gemini 4 Carbon 与 Gemini 4 Argon 采用相同的首发优惠价格：每百万输入 Token 2 美元，每百万输出 Token 10 美元。根据 Google AI Studio 文档，该优惠价格持续至 2026 年 11 月 30 日，此后价格将调整为每百万输入 Token 4 美元、每百万输出 Token 20 美元。 在编程和智能体能力方面，谷歌称，Carbon 能够处理跨多个软件包的迁移、跨子系统故障定位以及复杂架构重构等任务，还能通过构建、运行、验证和修复的循环完成全栈应用开发。谷歌同时正在 Google Antigravity 中预览 /swarm 功能，允许开发者通过一个提示词协调多个 AI 智能体，分别承担架构设计、任务协调和代码审计等工作，并在独立工作空间中并行执行任务。 网络安全是 Gemini 4 Carbon 的重点应用方向之一。谷歌公布的测试数据显示，该模型在 SEC-bench Pro 漏洞发现测试中取得 88.2% 的成绩，在 ExploitGym 漏洞利用测试中取得 54.8%，在 CWE-bench 漏洞修复测试中取得 71.0%。谷歌称，这些能力可用于识别软件漏洞、验证漏洞是否能够被利用，以及生成针对根本原因的修复代码。 谷歌还介绍了 Carbon 在实际安全研究中的应用。其 Cloud Vulnerability Research 团队曾利用该模型验证两项开源软件缺陷确实属于可利用漏洞，并协助维护人员将相关问题重新定级为严重漏洞，随后发布修复程序。Wiz 团队则在对两家大型 SaaS 服务商进行安全扫描时，利用 Carbon 在不到两小时内发现零日漏洞，并与受影响企业合作完成修复。 科学研究方面，谷歌称，Carbon 能够处理物理学、数学和生命科学领域的复杂推理任务。在蛋白质结构预测研究中，研究人员利用该模型从大规模未注释序列档案、环境及病毒序列目录和三维结构数据库中寻找远缘同源蛋白。在 CASP17 盲测集中的 7 个低同源蛋白家族测试中，Carbon 平均将检索到的同源序列数量提高了 40 倍，为后续结构预测提供更多信息。 安全防护方面，谷歌表示，Carbon 在 Gemini 4 Argon 的安全机制基础上，进一步强化了模型对提示词注入和网络攻击滥用的防护。在 Gray Swan 的间接提示词注入（IPI）基准测试中，该模型的攻击成功率为 0%。不…
items.summary_en: IT Home reported that on Nov. 10 local time, Google officially released Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, enterprises, researchers and consumers, calling it its most capable reasoning model, focused on complex software engineering, multi-step agent tasks, scientific research and cybersecurity. First announced on Oct. 28, the model had been available to some cyber defenders through the Fairwind cybersecurity partnership. Carbon is available to paid developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, and is rolling out to enterprise customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers across Google Antigravity, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Google Search; its model ID is gemini-4-carbon, it accepts text, image, video, audio and PDF input and outputs text, has a 1,048,576-token context window, a standard maximum output of 65,536 tokens, Long Decode extensibility to 1,048,576 tokens, and low, medium and high reasoning levels. Pricing matches Gemini 4 Argon: $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through Nov. 30, 2026, then $4 and $20. Google said Carbon can handle cross-package migrations, cross-subsystem fault localization and architectural refactoring, and complete full-stack development through build-run-verify-fix loops; Antigravity is previewing a /swarm feature that coordinates multiple agents from one prompt. On cybersecurity, Google said the model scored 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for vulnerability discovery, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation and 71.0% on CWE-bench for remediation, and described use cases by Cloud Vulnerability Research and Wiz. On science, Google said that in seven low-homology protein families in the CASP17 blind test set, Carbon increased the number of retrieved homologous sequences by 40 times on average; on safety, it said the model had a 0% attack success rate on Gray Swan's indirect prompt injection benchmark.
items.why_zh: 谷歌把旗舰模型定位到编程、科研与网络安全等高价值场景，并以低价和智能体工作流争夺开发者；性能与安全数据均为谷歌公布，需第三方验证（推测）。
items.why_en: Google is positioning its flagship model for high-value coding, science and cybersecurity use cases and competing for developers with low pricing and agent workflows; the performance and security figures are Google's own and need third-party verification (speculative).

items.title_zh: OpenAI 收购旅游初创公司 Odessia，探索 AI 旅行智能体业务
items.title_en: OpenAI Acquires Travel Startup Odessia to Explore AI Travel Agents
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，Odessia 创始人弗朗西斯 · 戴维森（Francis Davidson）今天宣布，OpenAI 已收购 AI 旅行智能体公司 Odessia，他本人也已经加入 OpenAI， 帮助这家 AI 初创公司探索旅游业务发展方向 。 据悉，Odessia 成立仅一年，就拿到了红杉资本领投的 600 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,011.9 万元人民币） 种子前融资，并在大约 5 个月前推出了 AI 旅游智能体服务，帮助早期用户规划价值数百万美元的旅行行程。 OpenAI 发言人证实了上述信息，并表示：“我们非常欢迎戴维森加入 OpenAI，他是一名经验丰富的从业者，曾创办多家帮助人们旅行的企业。我们很高兴看到他选择 OpenAI，共同开展新事业。” 不过，OpenAI 尚未公布任何旅游领域的新产品或计划。目前该公司的同领域合作伙伴有 Booking.com 缤客、Expedia 和 KAYAK。 对于未来是否会推出旅游相关产品 ， OpenAI 发言人没有透露更多信息 ，仅表示旅游是用户经常向 ChatGPT 咨询的话题之一。 OpenAI 收购 Odessia 还有另一个值得关注的原因：戴维森在旅游行业颇有名气。2014 年，他读大学期间就创办了旅游初创公司 Sonder。该公司的业务模式与 Airbnb 有些类似，但主要面向全球主要城市，提供高端公寓的短期租赁服务。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported that Odessia founder Francis Davidson announced that OpenAI has acquired the AI travel agent company Odessia and that he has joined OpenAI to help explore travel business directions. Odessia was founded only a year ago, raised a $6 million pre-seed round led by Sequoia Capital, and launched an AI travel agent about five months ago that helped early users plan trips worth millions of dollars. An OpenAI spokesperson confirmed the acquisition and praised Davidson as an experienced operator; however, OpenAI has not announced any new travel product or plan, its partners in the space include Booking.com, Expedia and KAYAK, and the spokesperson said travel is one of the topics users often ask ChatGPT about. Davidson founded Sonder, which offers short-term rentals of high-end apartments, in 2014 while in college.
items.why_zh: 这笔收购为 OpenAI 带来有旅游创业经验的团队，可能为 ChatGPT 的旅行规划与交易场景铺路，但产品计划尚未公布（推测）。
items.why_en: The acquisition brings OpenAI a team with travel startup experience and could pave the way for travel planning and transaction scenarios in ChatGPT, but no product plan has been announced (speculative).

items.summary_en: Ring’s new Drone Cam is a flying indoor security camera. Ring is finally shipping a flying indoor drone camera. For real this time. The Ring Drone Cam will arrive on January 27th, 2027, for $249.99 , Ring founder Jamie Siminoff said at a launch event in New York City this week. If it does actually ship, it will arrive almost six years after the company announced its first flying camera, the Ring Always Home Cam. Designed to patrol inside your home when you're not there, the Drone Cam is an AI-powered drone that can react to triggers from Ring sensors, such as detecting motion, a door opening, a water leak, or an alarm sounding. When triggered, it flies along preprogrammed routes to a set location, … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 推测：若按时上市，家庭安防可能从固定摄像头转向可移动巡逻，但隐私、可靠性和实际出货记录仍待验证。
items.why_en: Speculative: if it ships on time, home security could shift from fixed cameras to mobile patrols, but privacy, reliability and the company’s shipping record remain to be tested.

items.summary_en: As a California state senator, Scott Wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced AI. Now, after winning a tight congressional race for former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s open San Francisco seat, he could play a key role in setting federal AI policy. I spoke with Wiener on Friday, only a few hours after he had been declared the victor. But he was already thinking about AI risk. SB 1047, a bill that he authored in 2024, was set to become the first real piece of frontier AI legislation in the country before it was vetoed by California governor Gavin Newsom; he then sponsored SB 53, a lighter-touch bill that Newsom signed. items.why_en: Speculative: if Wiener enters Congress, he could bring state-level AI-safety legislative experience to the federal level, but federal legislative prospects remain uncertain.

items.summary_en: As companies look to accelerate innovation with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced modeling, the primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data, scientific expertise, and the practical realities of bringing products to market. For specialty chemicals manufacturer Lubrizol, digital transformation is all about giving researchers the tools to test ideas faster, make better-informed decisions, and develop more sustainable materials without compromising performance. Girish Rao, vice president of information technology at Lubrizol, says the company is building a digital foundation that connects business processes, modern data platforms, and cloud infrastructure to support its research and development (R&D) teams. Their goal is to combine decades of accumulated technical data with the deep expertise of chemists and engineers who understand customer needs as well as the physical constraints of their work. Data scientists can help identify patterns, test new hypotheses, and model possibilities before researchers conduct physical experiments. But, Rao emphasizes, “it’s not about replacing scientific judgment; it is about giving our scientists better tools.” Scientists, data scientists, and IT teams approach problems from different perspectives, prioritizing experimental validity, model performance, and platform security and scalability, respectively. items.why_zh: 推测：该案例说明传统工业企业在 AI 落地时，数据基础与跨职能协作往往比模型本身更关键。
items.why_en: Speculative: the case suggests that for traditional industrial firms, data foundations and cross-functional collaboration may matter more than models themselves.
